verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents running the complete platform in your own infrastructure. Docs cover a full local Docker environment and Kubernetes/OpenShift deployment with Helm charts and operators. A community user also evaluated Flagsmith as a self-hosted tool, though they found it less polished in places. Missing for 10: documented feature parity between self-hosted and SaaS editions (e.g., managed experimentation warehouse, licensed enterprise features), and smoother independent hands-on reports.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your data, security policies, and deployment environment.
This guide explains how to run a full Flagsmith environment on your local machine using Docker.
Kubernetes and OpenShift: Full Kubernetes deployment with Helm charts and operators
